note: Built by research/ctc-reference/crawl-v2.ts --build-frames. Each frame's sites are in crawl order; the crawl takes them in that order until the frame's quota is met.

brand.description: The v1 brand list, research/benchmark/sites.json (199 sites with an industry label), in a seeded random order.

tranco.description: A seeded random draw of 60 domains per rank band from the Tranco list 746PX, adult and gambling domains (by name) and brand-frame domains excluded and redrawn. Landing pages are further filtered after loading: not HTML, redirected off-site, parked, adult or gambling by content, below the web-page minimums.
tranco.domainTerms: research/ctc-reference/discover.ts DOMAIN_ADULT and DOMAIN_GAMBLING (substring of the domain); page terms PAGE_ADULT, PAGE_GAMBLING (two distinct terms of one kind) and PAGE_PARKED (one) in the title, meta description and first 2,000 characters of text

public.description: Government and nonprofit sites from public directories, interleaved by source.

sources.what: CISA's .gov registry, federal domains (1321); seeded sample of 45
the "State government website" USAGov lists on each of the 50 state pages, fetched at usa.gov's crawl-delay

sources.query: SELECT ?city (SAMPLE(?cityLabel) AS ?name) (MAX(?pop) AS ?population) (SAMPLE(?w) AS ?website) WHERE { ?city wdt:P17 wd:Q30; wdt:P1082 ?pop; wdt:P856 ?w; wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q515. ?city rdfs:label ?cityLabel. FILTER(LANG(?cityLabel) = "en") FILTER(?pop >= 400000) } GROUP BY ?city ORDER BY DESC(?population)
sources.what: US cities (subclasses of Q515) of 400,000 or more with an official website; tourism-board sites excluded

sources.query: SELECT ?o (SAMPLE(?label) AS ?name) (SAMPLE(?w) AS ?website) (MAX(?links) AS ?sitelinks) WHERE { VALUES ?type { wd:Q163740 wd:Q708676 wd:Q18325436 wd:Q7210356 } ?o wdt:P31 ?type; wdt:P17 wd:Q30; wdt:P856 ?w; wikibase:sitelinks ?links. ?o rdfs:label ?label. FILTER(LANG(?label) = "en") FILTER(?links >= 15) } GROUP BY ?o ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 400
sources.what: notable US nonprofits (15+ Wikipedia sitelinks) with an official website; government hosts and brand-frame domains excluded; seeded sample of 60
